# GM

Browser OpenMC geometry editor. Twenty-one editable examples across CSG, transport geometry and reactors, canonical CSG, GPU 3D and XY/XZ/YZ sections. Documents and autosaves stay in the browser. The HTTP endpoint processes only documents explicitly supplied to it.

- App: https://gm.keff.uk/
- Format: https://gm.keff.uk/docs/
- Example sources: https://gm.keff.uk/docs/benchmarks/
- Agent API: https://gm.keff.uk/docs/agents/
- Catalog: https://gm.keff.uk/api/models.json
- OpenAPI: https://gm.keff.uk/openapi.json
- MCP: https://gm.keff.uk/api/mcp

WebMCP tools: geometry_construct, geometry_catalog, geometry_open, geometry_get, geometry_add, geometry_focus, geometry_paint_lattice, geometry_undo, geometry_set_surface, geometry_export.
HTTP tools: geometry.empty, geometry.construct, catalog.list, geometry.template, geometry.focus, geometry.set_surface, geometry.validate, geometry.export.

Example materials are illustrative. Benchmark adaptations retain source and simplification metadata. GM does not run transport. Complex Boolean 3D meshes are approximations; sections and XML use canonical regions.

The optional assistant sends explicit user prompts and model documents to /api/assistant. OpenAI receives a geometry summary and returns a constrained construction plan. The server validates and applies it to a copy of the canonical document. Budgets are server enforced. Manual editing stays local.
